name: player_hit_callback_record_net_context_and_timed_status
description: Player::HitCallback_RecordNetContextAndTimedStatus is the lightweight network-player hit callback that skips inactive players, conditionally records recent-hit feedback, conditionally updates timed-hit status, and returns recentHitValid.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player combat/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43b810 validates fastcall ECX=saveState, EDX=hitSource, stack damage argument, inactive lifecycle return 0, recent-hit flag 0x1000 dispatch to Player::RecordRecentHitFeedback, timed-hit flag 0x200000 dispatch to Player::UpdateTimedHitStatusFromHitSource with the float return discarded, and final return of playerState->recentHitValid.

The native smoke verifies inactive skip, null hit-source return of recentHitValid, timed-hit status dispatch, recent-hit feedback dispatch, damage forwarding, owner/context capture, and recent-hit effect handle assignment.
